verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no statement, policy, or setting about AI model training: no opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-use policy. What it does show is related but different: local-only graphs, end-to-end encrypted sync, and a 'privacy-first' tagline. These are general privacy features, not a documented guarantee or control against training use, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
